terms.definition: The part of a plant that grows upward and supports the leaves and flowers, carrying water and food among them.
terms.function: Supports the plant and carries water up and food down.
terms.whereItIs: Rising from the roots up to the leaves and flowers.
terms.whyItMatters: The stem holds everything up and connects the underground root to the sun-catching leaves.

terms.definition: A point along the stem where a leaf, branch, or flower attaches.
terms.function: Provides the attachment points for a plant's side parts.
terms.whereItIs: At points along the length of the stem.
terms.whyItMatters: It is where leaves and flowers grow from the stem.

terms.definition: Tubes in the stem that carry water and minerals upward from the roots.
terms.function: Transports water up to the leaves.
terms.whereItIs: In the inner core of the stem tubes.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the water highway of the plant.

terms.definition: Tubes in the stem that carry the food made in the leaves down to the rest of the plant.
terms.function: Transports sugar food from the leaves to the rest of the plant.
terms.whereItIs: In the outer ring of the stem tubes.
terms.whyItMatters: It shares the plant's food with all its parts and storage.
